description: NaCdZn₂F₇ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Imma space group. Na is bonded in a distorted body-centered cubic geometry to eight F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.59 Å. Cd is bonded in a distorted body-centered cubic geometry to eight F atoms. There are a spread of Cd-F bond distances ranging from 2.23-2.54 Å. There are two inequivalent Zn sites. In the first Zn site, Zn is bonded to six F atoms to form corner-sharing ZnF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 51-53°. All Zn-F bond lengths are 2.05 Å. In the second Zn site, Zn is bonded to six F atoms to form corner-sharing ZnF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 47-51°. There are two shorter (2.04 Å) and four longer (2.07 Å) Zn-F bond lengths. There are four inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded to one Na, one Cd, and two Zn atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing FNaZn₂Cd tetrahedra. In the second F site, F is bonded to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Zn atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing FNa₂Zn₂ tetrahedra. In the third F site, F is bonded to two equivalent Cd and two equivalent Zn atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing FZn₂Cd₂ tetrahedra. In the fourth F site, F is bonded to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Cd atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing FNa₂Cd₂ tetrahedra.
